title: Preference-Conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Tactical Decision Making in Heavy-Duty Vehicles
abstract: arXiv:2601.18783v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A central difficulty in applying reinforcement learning to real-world applications such as autonomous driving is that conventional scalar reward formulations obtained by aggregating multiple often competing objectives may obscure the structure of their trade-offs. These challenges are particularly relevant to decision-making for heavy-duty vehicles, which requires balancing safety, efficiency, and operational costs under demanding commercial requirements. We present a preference-conditioned multi-objective reinforcement learning framework that explicitly represents these objectives and utilizes Generalized Policy Improvement and Proximal Policy Optimization to learn policies capturing different trade-offs between them. translated_title: 基于偏好条件的重型车辆战术决策多目标强化学习
translated_abstract: 将强化学习应用于自动驾驶等现实世界场景的一个核心难点在于，通过聚合多个通常相互冲突的目标而得到的传统标量奖励设计，可能会掩盖这些目标之间权衡关系的结构。这些挑战对于重型车辆的决策制定尤为突出，因为重型车辆需要在严苛的商业需求下平衡安全性、效率和运营成本。我们提出了一种基于偏好条件的多目标强化学习框架，该框架显式地表示这些目标，并利用广义策略改进和近端策略优化来学习能够捕捉这些目标之间不同权衡策略组合的策略。所提出的方法在三个相互冲突的目标之间逼近帕累托前沿：安全性（以碰撞和成功完成任务来量化）、能效（以能耗成本来量化）以及时间（原文摘要此处截断）。
tldr: 提出一种基于偏好条件的多目标强化学习框架，结合广义策略改进与近端策略优化，在安全性、能效和时间三个冲突目标之间逼近帕累托前沿，从而实现重型车辆的战术决策优化。
en_tdlr: A preference-conditioned multi-objective reinforcement learning framework that combines Generalized Policy Improvement and Proximal Policy Optimization to approximate the Pareto front across safety, energy efficiency, and time objectives for tactical decision making in heavy-duty vehicles.
